verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no AI-training policy or opt-out for Flagsmith's hosted service. The only relevant mechanism is self-hosting, which the docs say runs the whole platform in your own infrastructure with "full control over your data." That indirectly keeps data away from the vendor. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out for the SaaS offering, contractual or DPA language on AI training, and independent corroboration.
